steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with one vendor bid.
Enter the awarding screen where Tot. Proposal Value and line-item selection are shown.
Verify Tot. Proposal Value is zero before any line item is selected.
Capture the vendor's Sum Total for comparison after selection.
Select the available line item for awarding to the vendor.
Confirm the line item and vendor are selected for awarding.
Verify Tot. Proposal Value equals the vendor's Sum Total after selection.
